title: ChunkedCompressionOptions
description: Configuration schema for TTZip large-file adaptive chunked DEFLATE streaming pipeline

chunkSize.description: Size in bytes of each uncompressed chunk (default 1MB, must be 64KB aligned)

maxInFlightChunks.description: Maximum number of chunks in-flight across read, compression, and write stages to enforce <= 64MB RSS

enableZip64.description: Flag indicating if ZIP64 64-bit headers are enabled (automatically true if total size >= 4GB)

enableStoredBlockSync.description: Whether to append RFC 1951 0x0000FFFF empty stored blocks for byte-aligned block boundary synchronization
